title: From 89% to 98.5% CSAT: How BPO Transformed an E-Commerce Marketplace
summary: Kelly implements custom workforce solution for online marketplace expanding to 200 agents and improving CSAT from 89% to 98.5%. Case study.
body_markdown:
A Canada-based marketplace faced the challenge of transitioning from a brick-and-mortar to a hybrid e-commerce and classifieds giant. Kelly® delivered a strategic workforce solution that enabled rapid expansion to 200 customer support agents, increasing CSAT from 89% to 98.5%.


## The challenge: Transitioning from physical operations to a competitive digital platform and scaling to 200 agents.


>In 2010, Kelly formed a long-term partnership with an online marketplace to drive its evolution into a leading hybrid e-commerce and classified business. Starting from a modest brick-and-mortar footprint, the company needed an enterprise workforce partner to manage complex growth, offer bilingual support, and maintain exceptional customer service quality while scaling operations.


## The solution: Agile, hybrid business process outsourcing (BPO) model offering 24/7 customer service.


>Kelly delivered an integrated BPO solution, combining best-in-class technology, bilingual agents, and deep expertise in the automotive industry to ensure seamless 24/7 support — all delivered by a 100% Canadian-based team. By implementing an innovative hybrid workforce model, Kelly elevated the customer experience and enabled the client to expand into new digital markets with confidence.


## The results: 99% fraud prevention and CSAT from 89% to 98.5%.


Kelly met the challenge head-on demonstrating their ability to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of online marketplaces, implementing innovative strategies that resonate with users and drive unparalleled success.


-


**99% fraud prevention:** Strategic approach achieved 99% freedom from fraud, safeguarding users and securing the platform against scams.


-


**Cost Savings:** Optimizing processes and implementing technology achieved significant cost savings and increased profitability.


-


**CSAT 98.5%:** Kelly's support team increased the customer satisfaction score from 89% to 98.5%, solidifying the marketplace as a customer delight powerhouse.
